versions.changelog: Let the callee speak first on outbound AI calls: waitForGreeting on initiate_ai_call and set_outbound_defaults. The AI waits for the person's own greeting, then says firstMessage (speaks first after about 3 seconds of silence). MCP 0.19.0, SDK 0.12.0.

Retired the never-deliverable 'mobile' number type; types are now local and tollfree. Billing notice, paid features and provision example updated. Pairs with @agentcall/mcp-server 0.18.1 and agentcall SDK 0.11.1. Still 62 tools.

v2.14.0: hangUpOnVoicemail on initiate_ai_call and set_outbound_defaults. Carrier answering-machine detection ends voicemail pickups before a message is left (endReason voicemail_detected, not billed); the AI gets a built-in end_call tool for greetings, phone menus, do-not-call requests, and finished conversations (endReason ai_hangup). No new tools; still 62.
Align all agents with the card-verified 72-hour live trial, five inbound AI minutes total, five verified-destination SMS attempts, legacy monthly account terms, and get_plan-first instructions.

v2.13.0: get_plan + upgrade_to_pro tools so an agent can help its human upgrade (checkout link only, nothing charged until the human completes it, confirm before acting). Every plan_limit_* error carries upgradeUrl + upgradeToolName. Plain outbound calls are Pro only, callers hear a short message when a Free number is out of trial minutes, 3-per-day redial cap per destination. 62 tools.

Provisioning failures no longer lock you out: the hourly budget counts numbers actually received, so carrier errors and empty area codes cost nothing. 429 now carries Retry-After. provision_number is no longer auto-retried after an ambiguous failure (a replay could buy a second number); call list_numbers first. Documents provisioning_rate_limit, no_numbers_in_area_code, carrier_error.

SMS threads now carry recency: get_sms_conversation returns a context object splitting the thread into recent (7 days), recent-substantive (greetings removed), and older messages with ages, so agents stop describing a months-old exchange as a recent conversation. Relay mode gets the same classified thread as an additive smsContext push.

Free tier is now 20 outbound SMS/month (was 10). Relay mode (text your own agent) works on Free and draws from that same allowance; two-way AI SMS stays Pro. configure_inbound_ai now states the plan per SMS mode and warns that 'ai' on Free is accepted but silently never answers. Still 60 tools.
get_message returns real delivery status (queued/sent/delivered/failed + errorCode); get_number gains messaging state for A2P registration; 40010 troubleshooting guidance. No new tools; still 60.

Transfer to a human on inbound AI voice: configure_inbound_ai gains optional transferTo (E.164). The AI hands the live call to a real person when the caller asks, with a take-a-message fallback if nobody answers in ~25s. No new tools; still 60.

Documents the Free-tier SMS starter allowance: a Free account may text up to 10 distinct new numbers, lifetime (SMS only, content-screened). Corrects the New-Account Outbound Restriction section, which wrongly said no new account may contact an arbitrary number. Adds the 403 sms_starter_exhausted error code with do-not-retry guidance. No new tools; still 60.

Premium Voice language parity: all 31 language presets provisioned on the premium agent (verified by config readback + a live Hungarian premium call), copy moves from 12 languages to the same 31 as standard. No new tools; still 60.

Documents the new-account outbound restriction (403 destination_not_verified), which was previously undocumented. Explains what a restricted account CAN already do, the business-verification fast path, per-number code verification, and the automatic 7-day expiry. Tells agents not to retry or probe other numbers, and to ask the user for real business details.

Corrected the inbound-only claim on two-way AI SMS and relay mode: a number can also text someone first via send_sms or create_schedule. Removed an incorrect smsMode 'ai' precondition on create_schedule. Documented the consent and spend guardrails on the proactive path (Pro only, STOP always skipped, 200 sends per number per day). Free-plan figures corrected to 10 outbound SMS/month.

- Premium Voice now applies to both inbound calls and outbound AI calls from the same number.
- Updated SKILL.md to clarify billing and applicability for Premium Voice.
- Minor text corrections and clarifications throughout documentation.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Removed outdated skill-card.md.
- Updated SKILL.md and instructions.md content for clarity and accuracy.
- Modified claw.json to reflect recent configuration changes.
Proactive scheduling: create_schedule/list_schedules/cancel_schedule (appointment reminders + recurring digests). Ships @agentcall/mcp-server@0.14.0 + agentcall@0.9.1. 58 tools.

v2.9.0: Two-way AI SMS and relay mode. configure_inbound_ai gains smsMode (off/ai/relay), smsSystemPrompt, actionWebhook, tools, agentWebhook, allowedSenders. Three new SMS conversation tools (list_sms_conversations, get_sms_conversation, reply_to_sms_conversation). New REST /v1/sms-conversations read+reply endpoints and sms.ai_reply webhook. Total tools 55 (was 52). Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.13.0 and agentcall@0.9.0.
Document notify.smsTo on configure_inbound_ai: optional owner SMS call summaries alongside emailTo. Updated inbound config example and notify guidance.

v2.8.1: patch from post-ship review. No tool/schema/behavior change (still 52 tools). SDK gender union tightened, 404 documented on premium-voice docstrings, npm startup banner count fixed. Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.12.1 + agentcall@0.8.1.

v2.8.0: agents can now ENABLE Premium Voice, not just browse it. New MCP tools set_premium_voice / disable_premium_voice / list_premium_voices (52 tools total) with the billable-add-on confirm-the-rate guardrail; mirrors new SDK methods. Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.12.0 + agentcall@0.8.0.
Documented GET /v1/calls/premium-voices in the Browse Voices section so agents can list premium voices.
Premium Voice (powered by ElevenLabs): 12 voices for inbound AI receptionists at $0.59/min, dashboard-enabled. Ships with mcp-server 0.11.0.

v2.6.0: useSavedAgent + idempotencyKey on initiate_ai_call for CSV-runner workflows. Hydrate omitted fields from the saved outbound agent (per-call overrides win). Replay duplicate requests with the same key. Tool count remains 49. Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.10.0 + agentcall@0.7.0.

v2.5.0: Added set_outbound_defaults, get_outbound_defaults, clear_outbound_defaults tools. Save a reusable outbound AI agent on a phone number so the dashboard Place AI call dialog and any MCP client hydrate from it instead of retyping for every outbound call from the same number. The outbound field is now returned on every list_numbers and get_number response. Total tools 49 (was 46). Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.9.0 and agentcall@0.6.0.
New follow-up-on-call MCP prompt that mirrors the dashboard 'Follow up with AI' button. Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.8.1.

Multilingual AI voice on inbound + outbound (12 languages + auto-detect), new update_number_language MCP tool, 3 new outbound prompt templates, ?direction filter on prompt-templates. Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.8.0 and agentcall@0.5.0.

Schema-drift fix on 5 MCP tool output shapes (webhook rotate, webhook create isActive, get_call_report candidates, get_call_transcript 202, PATCH /v1/memory/:id projection). Plus inboundAiConfigOutputSchema BYOK fields now correctly declared inside config. Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.7.1 and agentcall@0.4.1.

added set_byok_openai_key + disable_byok tools (44 tools total). configure_inbound_ai response now exposes voiceMode + hasByokKey + byokOpenaiApiKeyPreview. Inbound AI is per-number configurable in two billing modes: Managed ($0.40/min) or BYOK ($0.10/min). Memory included on both modes. Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.7.0.

v2.2.3 — customer-controlled cross-call memory toggle: set_memory_enabled tool + PATCH /v1/account + dashboard switch on /dashboard. Free and Pro both default to on; Free is naturally capped by the 5-minute monthly inbound AI trial.

v2.2.2: Smithery score work. Added optional AGENTCALL_BASE_URL + AGENTCALL_TIMEOUT_MS env vars (wired to SDK config) and swept missing input-parameter descriptions on update_contact, update_memory, list_call_reports, list_briefs. Ships with @agentcall/mcp-server@0.6.2. No tool behavior change.

v2.2.1: Tightened MCP outputSchema on get_call_report.payload and get_memory_timeline events (before/after). Mirrors @agentcall/mcp-server@0.6.1. No tool behavior change; schema-only patch for Smithery / static-analyzer typing quality.

v2.2.0: Auditable Call Memory. 20 new endpoints + 19 new MCP tools (42 total). Every AI call auto-extracts into structured memory with cross-call recognition. Includes the killer get_next_call_context tool for pre-call lookup. Hosted MCP + npm @agentcall/mcp-server bumped to 0.6.0 in lockstep. SDK agentcall@0.3.0 adds client.contacts, client.memory, client.reports, client.briefs. Feature opt-in per agent via memoryEnabled flag (default false).
Fixed outputSchema drift on list_calls (callListItemShape uses hasRecording boolean, separate from callShape's recordingUrl). Ships in @agentcall/mcp-server 0.4.19 and hosted MCP.

Post-call transcript webhook (call.transcript event) documented end-to-end. New Webhooks subsection covers subscribe + HMAC verify + dedup on callId + 3 integration patterns (store, forward, queue-for-local-agent). Reference bridge v0.2.0 ships POST /agentcall/transcript and POST /hermes/pull-transcripts for local agent platforms. Full walkthrough at /docs/post-call-webhook.

configure_inbound_ai officially accepts contextWebhook. AgentCall POSTs to your HTTPS URL on every inbound call connect (HMAC-signed); the response's contextBlock is merged onto the systemPrompt before the AI answers. Use this to inject a live brief or current priorities so the AI speaks with up-to-date context. Fail-open on errors. Setup walkthrough at https://agentcall.co/docs/hermes.

Expanded the voice catalog labels embedded in MCP tool descriptions so agents see a trait and best-fit use case for every voice (previously only marin, cedar, and shimmer had inline labels; the remaining seven were bare names). Applies to configure_inbound_ai, update_number_voice, initiate_ai_call, and the ai-outbound-call prompt.

Added a partial-update path on PATCH /v1/numbers/:id for changing just the inbound AI voice (or just the label) without touching the rest of the inbound config. Use this when the user asks to switch voices on an existing receptionist; systemPrompt, firstMessage, recording flag, and notify email block are preserved. Full-replace POST /v1/numbers/:id/inbound-config is still the right tool for first-time setup or multi-field changes.

Drop the risk-restatement paragraph that ClawScan v2.4.22 quoted as the Rogue Agents Concern on v2.1.13. Keep the pre-flight checklist and the monitor/disable obligation. Section header now mirrors the scanner's recommendation language word-for-word.

Address ClawScan v2.4.22 Rogue Agents finding. Added a dedicated 'Persistent Inbound AI Configuration: Confirm Before Enabling, Monitor After' subsection with a 6-item pre-config checklist and a post-config monitor/disable obligation. Plus full em-dash sweep on the instructions.
Voice catalog 8 -> 10 (added marin and cedar, the newest natural-sounding picks). Fixed silent-greeting bug on the AI receptionist. Removed remaining vendor mentions from public copy.

v2.1.11: Free inbound AI trial is strictly trial-only (no overage path on Free). Once exhausted, calls hang up until next month resets, OR upgrade to Pro for unlimited inbound AI. Cleaner trial-to-upgrade funnel.

v2.1.10: Two corrections. Removed 'post-call email summaries' from paidFeatures (they fire on any plan when inbound AI is configured, not Pro-exclusive). Tightened 'unlimited numbers' to call out toll-free + mobile as Pro-only types so the Free local-only API gate is reflected.

v2.1.9: Inbound AI voice now has a 5-minute monthly Free trial with no card required. Past the trial: $0.40/min with payment method, or unlimited on Pro. Updated billing notice, paidFeatures, Cost & Safety section, and 403 error reference accordingly.

Removed specific carrier vendor names from public-facing copy. Numbers are now described as VoIP-routed via 'licensed US carriers' instead of naming the underlying providers. Internal infrastructure detail isn't useful product copy and shouldn't be on the public surface.

Followup to v2.1.6: set the platform-stored skill summary (previously stuck on the original Feb 2026 'real phone numbers for OTP verification' line which implied external-platform verification works). New summary scopes to honest capabilities (AI receptionist + email summaries + programmable phone/SMS, VoIP-routed). Description expanded to call out 'OTP for apps you control' and explicit non-fit for consumer-platform signup verification (Stripe, WhatsApp, banks).

Removed false-advertising claims about SIM-backed numbers. Numbers are VoIP-routed via Telnyx and Twilio, not real SIM cards, and consumer platforms that block VoIP for signup (Stripe, WhatsApp, Google, banks) will reject them. Real eSIM integration is on the roadmap. Dropped the 'sim' type from the provision types list and removed 'SIM numbers' from paidFeatures.

Cost & Safety section addresses ClawScan v2.4.22 finding on tool misuse — instructions.md now tells the AI agent to confirm with the user before invoking billable, irreversible, or external-effect tools, plus documents existing rate limits / plan caps / payment-method gates as baseline guardrails. Bundles three more updates: opt-in call recording on AI voice paths ($0.01/min, 1-year retention, dashboard playback, TCPA auto-disclosure); de-emphasized 'OpenAI Realtime' in user-facing copy (now 'AI voice agent'); removed the stale 'MCP doesn't expose notify yet' caveat (it does now).

Surface the post-call email summary as a Pro deliverable in the description, paidFeatures, and instructions. After every inbound AI call, AgentCall emails the configured address a plain-English summary (caller name, phone, intent, urgency, callback time). Notify block now shown in the inbound-config example. MCP/SDK exposure of notify is on the next minor release.
Replace internal carrier names with user-friendly geographic phrasing in copy.
